usedFor: Signwell sends documents for signature, and Asana tracks the follow-up when “Document Completed” runs “Create Task or Subtask”.

bestTemplate.name: “Document Completed” in Signwell, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A signed document becomes a task with an assignee and due date.

watchOut: “Document Sent” and “Document Completed” can both start “Create Task or Subtask”, so pick one to avoid duplicates.
